description: A listing that started before an invalidation is cached as fresh
old: /\ cache' = IF startGen = gen /\ (era = "legacy" \/ (~z /\ ~l)) THEN "fresh" ELSE "stale"

description: An invalidation leaves a fresh list fresh
old: /\ cache' = IF cache = "fresh" THEN "stale" ELSE cache

description: A stale list is served from the cache
A modern list with a zero-TTL page is cached
old: /\ cache' = IF startGen = gen /\ (era = "legacy" \/ (~z /\ ~l)) THEN "fresh" ELSE "stale"
new: /\ cache' = IF startGen = gen /\ (era = "legacy" \/ ~l) THEN "fresh" ELSE "stale"

description: A need during a listing starts another listing instead of joining it
Pages are requested past the page limit
An invalid cursor restarts the listing every time
A legacy list is cached even after an invalidation during its listing
old: /\ cache' = IF startGen = gen /\ (era = "legacy" \/ (~z /\ ~l)) THEN "fresh" ELSE "stale"
new: /\ cache' = IF era = "legacy" \/ (startGen = gen /\ ~z /\ ~l) THEN "fresh" ELSE "stale"

description: A failed listing leaves its waiters waiting
A new process keeps the previous process's list fresh
new:
/\ era' = e
    /\ gen' = gen + 1 /\ UNCHANGED cache

description: The last page asks for another page instead of finishing
old:
ELSE /\ page' = p /\ zeroTtl' = z /\ lapsed' = l
               /\ Finish(z, l)
new:
ELSE /\ page' = 0 /\ zeroTtl' = z /\ lapsed' = l /\ pending' = "first"
               /\ UNCHANGED <<listing, startGen, restarts, waiting, answer, cache, cacheGen,
                              cachedZero, cachedLapsed>>

description: A modern list with a page that expired before the listing ended is cached
old: /\ cache' = IF startGen = gen /\ (era = "legacy" \/ (~z /\ ~l)) THEN "fresh" ELSE "stale"
new: /\ cache' = IF startGen = gen /\ (era = "legacy" \/ ~z) THEN "fresh" ELSE "stale"

description: A failed listing hands its waiters the failure even when a list was listed before
A failed listing makes the last list fresh, so it is served from the cache instead of listed again
old:
/\ Failed
    /\ UNCHANGED <<era, process, gen, cache, cacheGen, cachedZero, cachedLapsed, startGen,
                   page, restarts, zeroTtl, lapsed, servedStale, extraFetch>>
new:
/\ Failed
    /\ cache' = IF cache = "none" THEN cache ELSE "fresh"
    /\ cacheGen' = gen
    /\ cachedZero' = FALSE
    /\ cachedLapsed' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<era, process, gen, startGen,
                   page, restarts, zeroTtl, lapsed, servedStale, extraFetch>>
